newsitem.title: UK: ATHLETICS-NEW YORK MARATHON CHAMPION CATUNA TO RUN IN LONDON.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-NEW YORK MARATHON CHAMPION CATUNA TO RUN IN LONDON.

text.p: New York marathon champion Anuta Catuna and world half marathon gold medallist Ren Xiujuan will run in the London marathon on April 13.

Romanian Catuna, 29, clocked a personal best of two hours 28 minutes 18 seconds in New York. She won the women's World Cup in 1995 and finished second in the Gothenburg world championships in the same year.
Chinese champion Ren, 22, finished ninth in last year's Atlanta Olympics before winning the world half marathon title in Palma, Majorca.
Britain's Liz McColgan will defend her title against Catuna, Ren and Chicago champion Marion Sutton, also from Britain.
"Liz McColgan's 1996 win was enormously popular but this April she will face an even stronger international field than last year," said international race director Dave Bedford.
"Having the New York champion and the world half marathon champion running will add a great competitive edge to the race. It's just the type of challenge Liz thrives on."
